exposure: Rh incompatibility (Rh-negative mothers with Rh-positive babies)
cohort: 164 neonates diagnosed with hyperbilirubinemia admitted to the neonatal care unit of Azadi Teaching Hospital in Kirkuk city.
finding: Severe hyperbilirubinemia was more prevalent in male neonates born >37 weeks, those with Rh incompatibility, delayed admission, and a family history of hemolytic diseases or affected siblings; early maternity discharge and delayed NCU admission were leading causes for exchange transfusion.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly associated with severe hyperbilirubinemia or exchange transfusion.
